ALTER PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CONSENT_CRM
AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_Consent AS (
	SELECT 
		BCC.VALUE AS ConsentId
		,BCC.DESCRIPTION AS ConsentName
		,NULL AS ConsentDescription
		,BCC.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,BCC.CATEGORYID AS CategoryId
		,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
		,BCCD.RECORD_STATUS 
	FROM BUSC.CRM_CATEGORIES_DELTA BCCD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.CRM_CATEGORIES BCC ON BCCD.BANK_ID = BCC.BANK_ID AND BCCD.CATEGORYID = BCC.CATEGORYID AND BCC.CATEGORYTYPE = 'CONSENT' AND BCC.isLatest = '1'
	WHERE BCC.CATEGORYID IS NOT NULL
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_Consent FROM TEMP_BNKM_Consent;


-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 

WITH TEMP_BNKM_Consent_SRC AS (
    SELECT 
        HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(ConsentId, ConsentName, FinancialInstitutionId, CategoryId)) AS HASHROW
        ,ConsentId
		,RECORD_STATUS
    FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CONSENT
    WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_Consent_TGT AS (
    SELECT  
        HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(ConsentId, ConsentName, FinancialInstitutionId, CategoryId)) AS HASHROW
        ,ConsentId
    FROM BNKM.Consent
	-- WHERE SOURCE_CODE = 'CRM'
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_Consent_DELTA AS (
	SELECT	
		SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
		,ISNULL(SRC.ConsentId,TGT.ConsentId) AS ConsentId
		,CASE
			WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
		ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_Consent_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_Consent_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.ConsentId = TGT.ConsentId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_Consent_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_Consent_DELTA;


---------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
[ConsentId] = SRC.ConsentId
,[ConsentName] = SRC.ConsentName
,[ConsentDescription] = NULL
,[FinancialInstitutionId] = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,[CategoryId] = SRC.CategoryId
,[SourceCode] = 'CRM'
,[WorkFlowId] = 0
,[TaskRunId] = 0
,[InsertDttm] = getDate()
FROM BNKM.Consent TGT 
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_Consent_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.ConsentId = TGT.ConsentId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_Consent SRC ON SRC.ConsentId = TGT.ConsentId ;


-------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.Consent (
	[ConsentId]
	,[ConsentName]
	,[ConsentDescription]
	,[FinancialInstitutionId]
	,[CategoryId]
	,[SourceCode]
	,[WorkFlowId]
	,[TaskRunId]
	,[InsertDttm])

SELECT     
	ConsentId
    ,ConsentName
	,ConsentDescription
    ,FinancialInstitutionId
    ,CategoryId
	,'CRM' AS SourceCode
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CONSENT
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');


DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_Consent;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_Consent_DELTA;

END
